raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
Some WGrad outputs reach the accumulation buffer through a functional add chain, especially repeated native and MXFP8 contributions.

Validate the complete left-linear chain before rewriting it, fuse supported producers in eager BF16 leaf order, and leave unsupported chains unchanged.

The PP gradient-accumulation hookup follows in #5208.

Validation: 24 WGrad tests passed.

detail.body:
Some WGrad outputs reach the accumulation buffer through a functional add chain, especially repeated native and MXFP8 contributions.

Validate the complete left-linear chain before rewriting it, fuse supported producers in eager BF16 leaf order, and leave unsupported chains unchanged.

The PP gradient-accumulation hookup follows in #5208.

Validation: 24 WGrad tests passed.
